components.title: ros-ocp-backend
components.description: Resource Optimization Service backend — Go microservice providing container/namespace/node/PVC/GPU optimization recommendations for OpenShift clusters. Deployed as part of Red Hat Cost Management.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for ros-ocp-backend (FedRAMP Moderate baseline)

implemented-requirements.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced via middleware that validates X-Rh-Identity header permissions against the RBAC service before allowing API access.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Implemented in internal/api/middleware/rbac.go. Graduated security enforcement (internal/config/security.go) ensures RBAC is enabled in production. See docs/operations/security-enforcement.md.

implemented-requirements.description: Account management is inherited from the Identity Provider (Red Hat SSO / Keycloak). ROS does not manage user accounts directly — it receives authenticated identity via X-Rh-Identity header injected by the API gateway.
implemented-requirements.remarks: MFA enforcement is an IdP responsibility. Documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md#multi-factor-authentication-mfa.

implemented-requirements.description: Structured JSON logging captures event type, timestamp, org_id, request_id, HTTP method, URI, status code, and latency for all API requests. Kafka processing logs include manifest_id, cluster_id, and file details.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Partially implemented: org_id present but username not yet extracted from identity header (finding AU-04). See internal/api/middleware/request_logger.go and internal/logging/logging.go.

implemented-requirements.description: Log integrity and protection is inherited from the platform logging infrastructure. CloudWatch (SaaS) provides encryption at rest, IAM-restricted access, and tamper-evident storage. On-prem relies on cluster log forwarder to customer SIEM.
SIEM integration is inherited from the platform. SaaS logs flow to Splunk/ELK via CloudWatch. On-prem logs flow to customer SIEM via OpenShift cluster log forwarder (ClusterLogForwarder CR).

Configuration settings enforcement via graduated security model. Production configurations (RBAC, DB TLS, Kafka TLS, dev token absence) validated at startup with three enforcement tiers: None (dev), Warn (on-prem default), Fatal (SaaS/Clowder).
Baseline configuration documented via SCAP/STIG mapping for UBI9-minimal container base image. DISA RHEL 9 STIG V2R2 controls mapped to container-applicable subset with verification commands.

User identification and authentication inherited from Identity Provider. API gateway (3scale) validates JWT, constructs X-Rh-Identity header. Service trusts gateway-injected identity within network perimeter (NetworkPolicy enforced).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Trust model documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md#identity-header-x-rh-identity. Accepted risk: no cryptographic verification at service layer (perimeter defense model).

implemented-requirements.description: Device/service identification via Kubernetes service accounts for internal endpoints. ROS_TAGS_ALLOWED_SERVICE_ACCOUNTS allowlist validates caller identity via TokenReview API. Pod-to-pod isolation enforced via NetworkPolicy.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Application implements SA validation; platform provides NetworkPolicy enforcement. Graduated security enforcement ensures dev tokens absent in production.

implemented-requirements.description: FIPS 199 security categorization completed. System categorized as Moderate impact (Confidentiality: Moderate, Integrity: Moderate, Availability: Low) based on information type analysis.
Risk assessment conducted per NIST SP 800-30 Rev 1 methodology. 10 threat scenarios analyzed with likelihood/impact scoring. Residual risk: 0 High, 0 Moderate, 5 Low (all mitigated or accepted).

Vulnerability scanning inherited from container registry (Quay.io/Clair) and CI pipeline (Tekton/GitHub Actions). Automated CVE scanning on every image push. Adversarial security reviews (7 rounds, 162+ findings) supplement automated scanning.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Image scanning by Quay.io. Manual reviews documented in docs/audit/.

implemented-requirements.description: Transmission confidentiality: TLS 1.2+ terminated at OpenShift Router (edge). DB connections use configurable sslmode (enforced in production via security enforcement). Kafka uses SASL_SSL. S3 access via HTTPS presigned URLs.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Service validates TLS configuration at startup (internal/config/security.go). Platform terminates external TLS. Documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md#tls-boundary.

implemented-requirements.description: FIPS-validated cryptographic protection via Red Hat golang-fips toolchain. Go crypto operations route to FIPS-validated OpenSSL 3.0 module when OS FIPS mode active. Build image: UBI10 go-toolset:1.25. Runtime: UBI9-minimal.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Application built with golang-fips; platform enables FIPS mode on nodes. Documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md#fips-cryptographic-protection.

implemented-requirements.description: Encryption at rest inherited from platform. PostgreSQL volumes encrypted via LUKS/EBS. Kafka broker disks encrypted. etcd encryption for Kubernetes secrets. No application-layer encryption needed (data classified Moderate, not High).
Boundary protection via OpenShift NetworkPolicy. Helm chart deploys deny-all ingress with explicit allow rules per component. External access only through OpenShift Route (TLS-terminated).
implemented-requirements.remarks: NetworkPolicy defined in cost-onprem Helm chart. Documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md#inherited-controls.

implemented-requirements.description: Input validation implemented across multiple layers: CSV formula injection sanitization (all export endpoints), SSRF protection (host allowlist, DNS rebinding check, private IP blocking), request body size limits, SQL parameterization via ORM.
implemented-requirements.remarks: CSV sanitization in internal/api/csv_sanitize.go. SSRF protection in internal/csv/csv_security.go. Request limits in internal/api/middleware/.

implemented-requirements.description: Flaw remediation inherited from Red Hat UBI image updates and Quay.io vulnerability scanning. Application dependencies managed via go.mod with Dependabot/Renovate for automated PRs.
implemented-requirements.remarks: UBI image patches published by Red Hat. Application tracks via Dockerfile FROM tag.

implemented-requirements.description: System security plan components documented: system boundary diagram, data flow inventory, trust model, inherited controls table, deployment-specific differences, and accepted risks register.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Documented in docs/fedramp/system-boundary.md. Full SSP deferred to platform-level ATO package.
